item.title: Cross-border payments set to transform African trade by 2026
item.description: As we approach 2026, the push for a seamless cross-border payment ecosystem has the potential to not only accelerate trade but also foster economic growth across Africa. Business owners would do well to prepare for the upcoming changes, ensuring they are not left behind in this evolutionary leap.

item.title: How overloaded Zim-bound bus travelled 700km through roadblocks from Durban to Polokwane
item.description: This Zimbabwe-bound bus (far right) traveled over 700km through multiple provinces and roadblocks before being intercepted at the Zebediela Traffic Control Centre. Despite being certified for only 63 passengers, it was found carrying 82 people, including 10 children.

item.title: Proposed salary hikes for high level government officials a 'slap in the face' for struggling South Africans
item.description: The recommendation of a 4.1% salary increase for public office bearers would see the President's annual salary rise by about R137,000 to approximately R3.4 million, and the Deputy President's salary increase by R130,000, taking his earnings to around R3.1 million a year.

item.title: Urgent search for three missing after vehicle swept away by floods in Amanzimtoti
item.description: A screengrab from a video shows a vehicle that has been washed away in flooding in Amanzimtoti. Three people are missing.

item.title: One dead, three missing after vehicle swept away in tragic KZN flash floods
